verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a REST API, an MCP server and agent integrations, so the question of agent credentials applies to it. Nothing in the evidence describes scoped, permission-limited or least-privilege API tokens. Creating separate workspaces for sandboxing is an adjacent control, not credential scoping, and the generic claim of 'simple and secure' access does not establish token scopes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
